summary: Ensign Group filed an 8-K disclosing a $60 million increase to its existing $40 million stock repurchase program, bringing total authorization to $100 million. The program allows open-market or privately negotiated repurchases under Rule 10b-18 and 10b5-1 plans. No price per share, premium, or expiration date was specified; repurchases are discretionary based on market conditions and liquidity. The board approved the increase on June 12, 2026, with no advisor named. The filing is a capital-return event, signaling management's view of undervaluation. Watch for actual buyback pace and potential EPS accretion as risk-arb angles.
